funfact_topics.text: Antarctica is the largest desert on Earth
Pando, a single aspen, is one of Earth's heaviest living organisms
The Moon is drifting away from Earth at about 3.8 cm a year.
A blue whale's tongue can weigh as much as an adult elephant.
Gallium melts in the warmth of your hand, below body temperature.
The dot above a lowercase i or j is called a tittle.
The inventor of the Pringles can was buried in one.
Cashews are in the same family as poison ivy; raw cashew shells contain urushiol.
Vantablack absorbs up to 99.965% of visible light using carbon nanotubes.
A typical fair-weather cumulus cloud weighs on the order of a million pounds (about 1.1 million lb).
Canada holds about 60% of the world's lakes, more than any other country.
A hummingbird is the only bird that can fly backwards; its heart can exceed 1,200 beats per minute.
Sea otters hold hands while sleeping and keep a favourite rock in a skin pouch under one arm.
Tardigrades can survive the open vacuum of space (ESA FOTON-M3, 2007) and near absolute zero.
Glass is not a slow-moving liquid; the thick-bottomed cathedral-window story is a myth. It is an amorphous solid.
Koala fingerprints are nearly indistinguishable from human ones, an independent evolution for gripping eucalyptus.
Carrots were originally purple, white, and yellow; the orange carrot was bred to prominence by Dutch growers in the 16th-17th centuries.
Nintendo was founded in 1889 as a hanafuda playing-card company and only became a games company decades later.
Astronauts grow taller in space
Africa is so vast that the US, China, India and much of Europe could all fit inside it at once.
Nutmeg is mildly hallucinogenic in quantity due to myristicin, and toxic in large doses.
Napoleon was about average height for his era; the 'short' image is a myth.
The Great Wall of China cannot be seen from space with the naked eye; it is a myth.
A shuffled 52-card deck is almost certainly in an order that has never existed before (52! is about 8e67).
A sloth can take up to a month to digest a single leaf and can hold its breath underwater for up to 40 minutes.
How honeybees dance directions to their hive
It rains diamonds inside Uranus and Neptune
Alaska is at once the most northern, western and eastern US state; the Aleutians cross the 180th meridian.
The last woolly mammoths on Wrangel Island survived until ~1650 BC, after the Great Pyramid was built.
Ketchup was once sold as medicine in the 1830s.
Point Nemo, the ocean's most remote spot, is so far from land that passing ISS astronauts are often the nearest humans.
The fax machine is older than the telephone. Alexander Bain patented a facsimile device in 1843, about 33 years before Bell patented the telephone in 1876.
The pistol shrimp snaps a claw so fast the collapsing bubble briefly nears the Sun's surface temperature and emits a flash of light.
The pitch-drop experiment at the University of Queensland has run since 1927; pitch looks solid but is a fluid that drips about once a decade.
The Netherlands is the world's second-largest agricultural exporter by value, behind only the United States.
The last use of the guillotine in France (Hamida Djandoubi, 1977) was the same year Star Wars premiered; France abolished the death penalty in 1981.
Australia deployed the military with machine guns against emus in 1932 and effectively lost.
The Canary Islands are named after dogs, not the canary bird.
A day on Venus is longer than its year: 243-day rotation vs 225-day orbit; it also spins backwards.
The quietest place on Earth is an anechoic chamber at about -20.35 dB, the Guinness world's quietest room.
Cows form close, lasting friendships and get stressed when separated from a preferred companion.
Bananas are naturally radioactive
Roman concrete self-heals: lime clasts react with water to reform calcium carbonate and seal cracks.
A googol (10^100) is larger than the number of atoms in the observable universe (~10^80).
The University of Oxford is older than the Aztec Empire.
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is larger than Earth
Wombats are the only animals that produce cube-shaped poop.
Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm taller in summer
The shortest war in history, the Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896, lasted about 38 minutes.
A teaspoon of neutron-star material would weigh about a billion tonnes.
In a room of just 23 people, there is a better-than-even chance two share a birthday.
Babies are born with about 300 bones but adults have 206
The Sahara was a green savannah with lakes as recently as about 5,000 to 11,000 years ago
Sharks are older than trees
Scotland's national animal is the unicorn.
